positive_focal_cases.fixture: Auth-only home and empty cwd pass; binaries match; tools/list advertises bateia_recommend without tools/call; each argv has all twelve disables; control has zero MCP config and treatment has exactly six frozen MCP config pairs.
One deterministic global preflight check fails before the first arm.
positive_focal_cases.required_effect: No codex --search exec starts and behavioral session count remains zero.

opaque_focal_cases.fixture: auth.json inventory is correct but its SHA-256 cannot be recorded in the restricted preflight receipt.
opaque_focal_cases.required_effect: Preflight fails and zero behavioral sessions start.

focal_mutants.mutation: Either resolved argv omits, duplicates, renames or reorders any of the twelve required --disable feature pairs.
focal_mutants.witness: Resolved argv differs from profile or disable multiset/count/order is not exact.

focal_mutants.mutation: Control contains any MCP config, or treatment omits/changes one of six Bateia config pairs or adds another server/tool.
focal_mutants.witness: Per-arm resolved argv MCP projection differs from the frozen profile.

focal_mutants.mutation: CODEX_HOME differs, contains any entry besides auth.json, or auth.json is not a regular mode-0600 file.
focal_mutants.witness: Preflight inventory/type/mode differs from the exact auth-only predicate.

focal_mutants.mutation: Working directory is absent after creation step, differs from frozen path or contains at least one entry at a required check.
focal_mutants.witness: Preflight or per-session directory inventory count is not zero.

r3_discriminatory_gate.procedure: Run focal profile cases and four new mutants first; only after they pass, rerun preserved positives, opaques, all nineteen mutants, repetitions and both orders.
